translation: Thirty-six: Last winter I met the words of the Perfected Sun on cultivating Kunlun, and extended and practiced them, seeing effect at every step. Just as when the mountains are exhausted and the waters are spent, suddenly the willows are dark and the flowers bright, the realm cannot be imagined, and in the blink of an eye it is hard to recall; I recorded it with the brush as it came, writing directly without ornament. The intention is to share the good with others, not sparing the detail of the words, and among them there is no lack of repetition and contradiction.
